id: title:andehen:add taxonomy entry for experiment exposure

review.posthog_relevance: Adds taxonomy and HogQL query support for the $experiment_exposure event, enabling users to filter and query experiment exposure alongside feature flags.
review.reason: Adds a new taxonomy entry for $experiment_exposure and updates HogQL query filters and documentation, supporting the Early Access Features product. This is a localized maintenance and documentation update rather than a systemic capability or critical reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the supplied hunks; no release notes, adoption metrics, or incident avoidance are available. The benefit is inferred from the code changes, not verified by external outcomes.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are from a single chunk. No PR metadata, release notes, or adoption context is provided, so tier assignment and benefit claims are not supported.

observations.behavior: Adds a new taxonomy entry for the $experiment_exposure event, including its label, description, ignored_in_assistant flag, and primary property, while also updating documentation and test snapshots to include this event in relevant queries.

observations.code_quote: "description": 'The feature flag that was called.\n\nWarning! This only works in combination with the $feature_flag_called and $experiment_exposure events. If you want to filter other events, try "Active feature flags".',
